metadata.title: Validate Process-Steps Exist
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Validate that all process-steps referenced in a template exist. Use when creating or reviewing templates.

output.description: Validation report of existing vs. missing process-steps

specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read template → extract references → check existence → create report → handle missing
If missing steps found: either spawn sub-processes or PAUSE for manual creation

update: memory.json (current step section with validation results)

tools: read_file - Read template and check step files
bestPractices: Check both MD and JSON files exist for each step
Document all missing steps with their expected locations
Provide clear report of validation results

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read template file
substeps.description: Load the template content for analysis
actions: Read the template MD file
Read the template JSON file if exists
Document template being validated

substeps.name: Extract step references
substeps.description: Find all @framework-step references in the template
actions: Search for @framework-step:category/step-name pattern
Create list of all referenced steps
Note the category and name for each reference

substeps.name: Check step existence
actions: For each reference, check .processes/steps/{category}/{step-name}.md exists
Also verify .processes/steps/{category}/{step-name}.json exists
Mark as valid if both files exist
Mark as missing if either file doesn't exist

substeps.name: Create validation report
actions: List all valid step references
List all missing step references
Calculate validation summary (X of Y valid)

substeps.name: List missing steps
actions: For each missing step, document expected path
Document category and name
Suggest creation approach

substeps.name: Handle missing steps
substeps.description: Determine how to handle missing steps
actions: Option A - Sub-Process: If autoSpawnMissing or user approves, spawn create-process-step-template sub-process for each missing step
Option B - PAUSE: If user prefers manual, PAUSE and list missing steps
Document decision in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: read template → extract references → check existence → create report → list missing → handle missing

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Template file path from previous step
fields: Information Produced: Validation results, missing steps list, spawned sub-processes (if any)
Decisions Made: How to handle missing steps
